method: Computer Use through native Windows UI in an isolated synthetic fixture
observations: Remove workspace button fits the workspace toolbar; live tab rows identify their workspace and the account heading explains shared vault scope.

Selected only the generated fixture workspace and opened its removal confirmation. The warning named that workspace, described deferred profile cleanup and listed preserved vault/download/source files. No was the default button.
Selected No; the warning closed and the workspace and both live tab rows remained. No removal was approved through the UI.
Opened fixture Controls and closed it to hide it before the website confirmation.
Clicked Confirm synthetic logout on the human-owned fixture page.
Controls reappeared without an activation request and selected the exact fixture tab; website confirm message and loopback origin were visible.
Clicked Dismiss; fixture telemetry separately verified one dismissal, unchanged document and human ownership.
limits: This synthetic check does not verify the PD Portal logout flow.
The automatic password Save/Update flow was not exercised.
Workspace deletion completion was tested separately through the unshipped native driver, not by accepting this UI confirmation.
